estimator.cv: analysis/cv_analysis.analyse_backbone (paired host-cluster bootstrap over 818 hosts, default_rng(20261008).multinomial, 2000)
estimator.loco: pooled seed-ensemble out-of-fold predictions (seeds 0-2); dftgnn.stats.g1.HierDraws with one resample over the hosts of the set (2000, seed 20261008), as in scripts/analysis/ingest_m1_recompute.loco; per-fold, per-family-removed and greedy bounds are new draws of the same estimator on the reduced host set (descriptive)
estimator.precision: analysis/precision_analysis.analyse (G1 estimator; HierDraws over 30 or 10 resamples)
estimator.sweep: dftgnn.stats.g1: seed-ensemble mean, paired hierarchical bootstrap (HierDraws), 2000 replicates, seed 20261008, one draw set for S, D, P, B0, RF, every budget and both networks
estimator.upper_below_delta: one-sided 95% upper bound strictly below delta

payload.label: DERIVED (C1); default-initialisation ablation = v1; no new runs

baseline_points_vs_standalone_records.reference: results/b0_physics_floor.json, results/rf_kumagai.json payload.outer.*.aggregate.mae.mean (points; their intervals use a host-cluster bootstrap with seed 0)

v1_S_D_A_vs_g1_primary.reference: results/g1_primary.json payload.per_budget (MAE_S, MAE_D, A: mean, ci, upper_one_sided, boot_sd, sd_over_resamples, per_resample)

v2_points_vs_c1c2_v2.reference: results/c1c2_v2.json payload.A_mae, mae (points only: its intervals came from the collaborator's bootstrap, a known estimator difference listed in results/freeze_table.json)

site_resolution.definition: mean over (resample, test host with >= 2 sites) of the SD of the seed-ensemble prediction across the host's sites, divided by the same SD of the DFT targets (results/g1_diagnostics.json definition; v2 computed here with the same code)

s10b_forensic_v1_S.definition: median over 30 resample-0 hosts of the SD of S (resample 0, seed 0) across labelled sites, trained checkpoint, over the median target SD

table.arm: default-initialisation network (ablation); called v1 in the repository, originally registered

B400_30x5.design: outer resamples 0-29 x seeds 0-4 (precision extension, pooled)
B400_30x5.missing: P, RF and B0 were not run on resamples 10-29 or with seeds 3-4
